gates.required: Recorded owner decisions for mission intent, evidence lifecycle, execution records, verification and conformance.
Versioned mission, execution, evidence, verification and conformance contracts.
Identity, tenant, authorization, revocation, scope and purpose enforcement.
Retry, idempotency, rollback, quarantine, compensation and escalation semantics.
Approved persistence schema and rollback plan.
Bounded existing-boundary implementation only after preceding gates.
Independent contract, security, tenant, failure, provenance and conformance evidence.
Evidence package and independent conformance assessment.

acceptance: Mission intent has stable identity, tenant, purpose, authority, context, lifecycle, owner, version and non-scope.
Unauthorized, cross-tenant, expired, revoked and out-of-scope execution fails closed.
Execution records are idempotent and distinguish request, attempt, result and external effect.
Evidence preserves producer, actor, tenant, observation time, recording time, provenance, integrity, lifecycle and lineage.
Verification cannot be inferred from worker completion or execution success.
Failure, retry, rollback, quarantine and escalation preserve history.
Claims advance only when corresponding evidence exists.

rollback.code: Revert bounded changes after preserving test and verification output.
rollback.data: No persistence mutation before approved migration and rollback procedure.
rollback.architecture: No registry, mother-surface, phase or ownership mutation authorized by this qualification.

nextDecision: Whether Mission Orchestration is a CoreGrid product mechanism.
Universal evidence identity and lifecycle owner.
Status semantics for COMPLETE, VERIFIED, CONFORMANT, DEPLOYED and OPERATIONAL.
